exposure: Group educational sessions on all methods of birth control with an emphasis on LARC
outcome: Actual usage of LARC methods (subdermal implant, intrauterine device)
cohort: The study involved 41 female students from a 4-year public college in North Carolina.
finding: LARC knowledge scores and intention to use significantly improved, with an observed increase in subdermal implant usage but no change in intrauterine device use.
